title: Antonios Kagialis
text:
Antonios Kagialis was born in Heraklion, Greece. He is an MSc student in Methodology and Statistics in Behavioral, Biomedical and Social Sciences, Utrecht University. He holds an MSc in Neuroscience from the Medical School at the University of Crete and completed his undergraduate degree in Psychology at the University of Nicosia, Cyprus. The common factor in his research is the influence of emotional and cognitive processing on maladaptive behaviors and well-being across diverse contexts. His work spans neuropsychiatric disorders, social and romantic relationships, addictive behaviors, and cross-cultural pandemic environments, examining how disruptions in these processes contribute to psychological distress in each framework. He currently serves as the co-Chair of the Science Committee at the Society for Global Psychology, American Psychological Association.
The University of Nicosia awarded him the “Best Bachelor’s Degree Graduate Award” for the academic year 2020-2021 and received an academic excellence award from the Cypriot Professional and Scientific Psychological Association. Antonios has also received a 2023-2024 Psi Chi- the International Honor Society in Psychology Presidential citation and a 2024-2025 Presidential citation and the 2026 Jean Lau Chin Award from the Society of Global Psychology (APA DIV52), American Psychological Association.
